tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Минулий час від be: I / he / she / it → was; you / we / they → were. Заперечення: wasn't, weren't. Питання: Were you…? Was he…? Приклади: I was a champion. The fans were everywhere. They weren't interested. Where were you yesterday?
tasks.q_pl: Czas przeszły od be: I / he / she / it → was; you / we / they → were. Przeczenie: wasn't, weren't. Pytanie: Were you…? Was he…? Przykłady: I was a champion (Byłem mistrzem). The fans were everywhere. They weren't interested. Where were you yesterday?
tasks.q_en: Past of be: I / he / she / it → was; you / we / they → were. Negative: wasn't, weren't. Questions: Were you…? Was he…? Examples: I was a champion. The fans were everywhere. They weren't interested. Where were you yesterday?

s1.q: Маккуїн: «Look! Who is that on the track?» (Дивись! Хто це на трасі?)

s4.q: Док: «Yes, I was. When I came back, they weren't interested.» (Так. Коли я повернувся, їм було нецікаво.)

choices.fb: Ой! Це дуже боляче для Дока.

end_good.title: Кінцівка: Він тобі довіряє
end_good.text: Док мовчить, потім тихо каже: «Thank you, kid». Уперше він не сердитий.
end_good.text_pl: Doc milczy, potem cicho mówi: „Thank you, kid”. Pierwszy raz nie jest zły.
end_good.text_en: Doc is quiet, then says softly: “Thank you, kid.” For the first time he isn't angry.

end_mid.title: Кінцівка: Тиха ніч
end_mid.text: Док киває й їде в гараж. Ви знаєте правду, але він ще сам.
end_mid.text_pl: Doc kiwa głową i jedzie do garażu. Znacie prawdę, ale on wciąż jest sam.
end_mid.text_en: Doc nods and drives to his garage. You know the truth, but he's still alone.

end_bad.title: Кінцівка: Двері зачинено
end_bad.text: Док сердито їде геть і зачиняє гараж. Спробуй ще раз: was / were і добрі слова.
end_bad.text_pl: Doc ze złością odjeżdża i zamyka garaż. Spróbuj jeszcze raz: was / were i dobre słowa.
end_bad.text_en: Doc drives away angrily and closes his garage. Try again: was / were and kind words.
